headline.text: L1 S3 candy reserve tank drained after *soft plastic* material found during verification — origin unknown, maintenance could not identify source.

summary: One foreign material investigation open at L1 S3 — soft plastic recovered from candy reserve tank, origin not yet determined. Three additional food-safety flags: missing bolt at L3 ML4 depositor, wrenches left on L1 S2 conveyor, and damaged Sweco screen at L3 ML4 (replaced, ATP passed). L1 S4 level-2 clean incomplete due to staffing.

food_safety.title: Soft plastic FM found in S3 candy reserve tank
food_safety.summary: During candy level verification at 01:20, kitchen operator found soft plastic material in reserve tank; tank drained and material recovered, but maintenance unable to determine origin because material type not normally used in that area.
food_safety.status: Investigation ongoing — material secured for evaluation, origin unknown.

food_safety.title: Wrenches left on S2 conveyor C13
food_safety.summary: Operator found two wrenches left on top of C13 conveyor — tools on food-contact surface, no evidence of entry into product stream.
food_safety.status: Resolved — tools removed, owner not identified.

food_safety.title: Missing bolt on ML4 depositor 2 nozzle plate
food_safety.summary: Operator identified missing bolt on depositor 2 nozzle plate during disassembly at shift end; maintenance to install replacement during reassembly.
food_safety.status: Resolved — bolt replaced during cleaning window before next production run.

food_safety.title: ML4 Sweco screen damaged during cleaning
food_safety.summary: Operator placed clean Sweco screen on disassembled unit without LOTO, then powered wrong Sweco, shredding screen; operator coached on GMP and LOTO procedures.
food_safety.status: Resolved — replacement screen installed, washed, ATP passed before startup.

quality.title: ML4 unfilled bars reached checkweigher
quality.summary: Checkweigher rejected caddies at 13:07 due to low weight; inspection found unfilled bars that had been marked at de-molding but still passed through with two operators present.
quality.status: Resolved — defective bars removed, supervisor coached de-molding team on break coverage and continuous visual verification.

sanitation.title: S4 level-2 clean incomplete at shift end
sanitation.summary: Night shift completed level-2 clean and ATP on lanes 10–17 and Theegarten only; rest of line left undone due to insufficient staffing.
sanitation.status: Open — partial clean documented with photos, remaining areas to be addressed.

allergen.title: ML1 allergen supersack wrap substitution
allergen.summary: Blue shrink wrap for allergen supersacks unavailable (WHS out); partial supersack wrapped in clear wrap and labeled as Allergen per team decision.
allergen.status: Resolved — supersack wrapped with clear material and labeled Allergen; blue wrap restocked needed.

opportunities.text: Consider adding scraper position and security check to S3 startup checklist — today's loose scraper caused chocolate buildup and nearly pulled air line into roller before operator stopped line.
Review LOTO enforcement during ML4 equipment disassembly — today's Sweco screen was damaged when operator powered unit without verifying isolation.
Consider visual inspection audit frequency at ML4 de-molding — today's unfilled bars were marked but still reached checkweigher with two operators present.
